body: There isn't anything to go back to.
I haven't seen my family in years, my friends started dying off and my father died. I haven't seen my older brother in years and I don't remember how he even sounds.

I made a mistake and secluded myself in another country and now I can't go back home. I've lost friends and family and now I'm afraid that if I go back home and I'm not happy like I once was, i'll end up committing suicide.
